version.promotionalText: Borrow, lend and organize books with your community of readers. Inventaire.io turns your friends into one big living library.
version.description:
Welcome to Inventaire.io — the app that turns your friends into a living library!

With Inventaire.io you can:
• Build your book inventory in seconds
• Explore the libraries of your friends and the groups you belong to
• Borrow, lend and share your favorite reads
• Search for any book in a snap

Our mission: spread reading around you and give books back their power to bring people together.

Inventaire.io is the official mobile client of the free and collaborative inventaire.io project. Join a kind community of passionate readers!
